detailedProjects.title: Zogor Place
paragraphs: Oryx Carpentry completed the carpentry work for Zogor Place, a 400-square-meter space. We used high-quality car-painted MDF wood to ensure durability and an elegant finish. The work included custom-built cabinetry, shelving, and wall paneling — crafted with precision and attention to detail.
The design was tailored to the client’s vision, blending modern aesthetics with functional space solutions. The client expressed strong satisfaction with both functionality and style.

detailedProjects.title: Villa in Dream City
paragraphs: We designed and crafted a unique bedroom feature including a custom balloon door made using high-quality MDF with integrated lighting — a functional centerpiece for the room. The project also involved custom-built furniture and decorative woodwork that complemented the overall villa design.

detailedProjects.title: Villa in Ankawa
paragraphs: Oryx Carpentry completed a fully customized dressing room, built with MDF wood, including wardrobes, shelving, and storage solutions designed to maximize space. The project required precision and premium finishing to match the villa’s interior style.

detailedProjects.title: Empire Square
paragraphs: In this project, Oryx Carpentry delivered modern carpentry solutions including a decorative TV wall and wooden partition. The work was completed using MDF wood, with clean lines and a refined finish for a contemporary interior feel.
